questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write the subjunctive of 'pouvoir' for 'elles': pour qu'elles ___ étudier.
questions.hint: The stem is 'puiss-'.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write the subjunctive of 'faire' for 'il': pour qu'il ___ ses devoirs.
questions.hint: The stem is 'fass-'.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Choose the correct form: J'aide à la soupe populaire pour que les sans-abri ne ___ pas faim. (avoir)
questions.hint: Use the 'ils' form of the subjunctive of avoir.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write the subjunctive of 'aider' for 'nous': pour que nous ___ les autres.
questions.hint: For nous, the subjunctive looks like the imperfect.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Il faut agir pour que la pauvreté diminue.
Il faut agir pour que la pauvreté diminuer.
Il faut agir pour que la pauvreté diminuera.
Il faut agir pour que la pauvreté diminuait.
questions.answer: Il faut agir pour que la pauvreté diminue.
questions.hint: The verb after 'pour que' must be in the subjunctive.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Translate: 'I volunteer so that I can help others.' (same subject in both parts)
options: Je fais du bénévolat pour aider les autres.
Je fais du bénévolat pour que j'aide les autres.
Je fais du bénévolat pour que j'aidais les autres.
Je fais du bénévolat que aider les autres.
questions.answer: Je fais du bénévolat pour aider les autres.
questions.hint: When the subject is the same, use 'pour' + infinitive.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write two sentences in French about why you would like to volunteer for a charity. Use 'pour que' in one of them.
questions.hint: Example structure: Je voudrais…, pour que les gens…

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: In French, give your opinion on how young people can help to fight poverty, with one reason.
questions.hint: Use 'À mon avis…' and 'parce que…'.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: How many Sustainable Development Goals were agreed by the United Nations in 2015?
questions.hint: It is between 15 and 20.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: By which year are the Sustainable Development Goals meant to be achieved?
questions.hint: They were set 15 years after 2015.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is fair trade?
options: A system that guarantees producers a fair minimum price
A loan from the World Bank
questions.answer: A system that guarantees producers a fair minimum price
questions.hint: It aims to protect farmers in lower-income countries.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is the name for very small loans given to people who cannot borrow from banks?
questions.hint: The prefix means 'very small'.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which is an example of appropriate technology?
options: A hand-operated water pump that locals can repair
questions.answer: A hand-operated water pump that locals can repair
questions.hint: It suits the skills and resources of the local community.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Aid given directly from one government to another is called…
questions.hint: 'Bi' means two.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Aid that must be spent on goods or services from the donor country is called…
questions.hint: It has conditions attached to it.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which type of development project involves local people in planning and decision-making?
questions.hint: It starts with the community rather than the government.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which is a disadvantage of large top-down projects such as mega-dams?
questions.hint: Think about what happens to land flooded by a reservoir.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which is a benefit of fair trade for farming communities?
options: A premium that can be spent on community projects
questions.answer: A premium that can be spent on community projects
questions.hint: Extra money goes to schools, clinics or clean water.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Why can aid sometimes create dependency?
options: Countries may rely on aid instead of building their own economy
Aid is always too small to matter
Aid is only given to rich countries
questions.answer: Countries may rely on aid instead of building their own economy
questions.hint: Think about the long-term effect of receiving help every year.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which of these is one of the Sustainable Development Goals?
questions.hint: The goals focus on people, planet and prosperity.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is the name for an organisation such as a charity that works independently of governments?
questions.hint: The initials stand for non-governmental organisation.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Explain why small-scale, bottom-up projects are often considered more sustainable than large-scale projects.
questions.hint: Consider cost, local skills, maintenance and who benefits.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: For a named development project you have studied, evaluate how far it has improved the quality of life of local people.
questions.hint: Give specific benefits and limitations, then reach a judgement.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Assess the advantages and disadvantages of microfinance as a strategy for development.
questions.hint: Think about women's businesses, interest rates and debt.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year did the Hungarian uprising take place?
questions.hint: It happened in the same year as the Suez Crisis.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which city did the uprising begin with student protests?
questions.hint: It is the capital of Hungary.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which Soviet leader's 'Secret Speech' in 1956 criticised Stalin?
questions.hint: He became the leading figure in the USSR after Stalin's death.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What is the term for the policy of moving away from Stalin's harsh methods?
questions.hint: It adds a prefix meaning 'removing' to Stalin's name.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Who became Prime Minister of Hungary during the uprising and announced reforms?
questions.hint: He was a reform-minded communist.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which reform most alarmed the Soviet Union?
questions.hint: It threatened the USSR's military alliance in Eastern Europe.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What was the name of the military alliance of the USSR and its Eastern European satellite states?
questions.hint: It was named after the capital of Poland.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: How did the USSR respond to the uprising in November 1956?
options: It sent tanks and troops into Budapest
It accepted all of Nagy's reforms
It asked the United Nations to decide
questions.answer: It sent tanks and troops into Budapest
questions.hint: The response was military.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Who was installed as the new pro-Soviet leader of Hungary after the uprising?
questions.hint: He led Hungary for over thirty years afterwards.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What happened to Nagy after the uprising?
options: He was arrested and later executed
He became leader of the USSR
He moved to the USA as president
He was made head of the Warsaw Pact
questions.answer: He was arrested and later executed
questions.hint: The Soviets wanted to make an example of him.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: How did Western countries respond to the uprising?
options: They condemned it but did not intervene militarily
They sent troops to help Hungary
They declared war on the USSR
questions.answer: They condemned it but did not intervene militarily
questions.hint: They feared starting a wider war.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which event distracted Britain and France at the same time as the Hungarian uprising?
questions.hint: It involved a canal in Egypt.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What was one consequence of the uprising for the Eastern Bloc?
options: It showed the USSR would use force to keep control
questions.answer: It showed the USSR would use force to keep control
questions.hint: Think about the message sent to other satellite states.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Explain why the Hungarian uprising broke out in 1956.
questions.hint: Consider de-Stalinisation, hardship under Soviet control and national feeling.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Explain why the USSR decided to crush the uprising rather than accept Nagy's reforms.
questions.hint: Think about the Warsaw Pact, the buffer zone and the example to other states.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: 'The main consequence of the Hungarian uprising was to strengthen Soviet control over Eastern Europe.' How far do you agree? Give reasons.
questions.hint: Weigh this against consequences for the West, for Khrushchev and for Hungary itself.

math.topic: Circle theorems: cyclic quadrilaterals, alternate segment and chord properties

questions.subject: math
questions.q: In a cyclic quadrilateral, one angle is 72°. What is the size, in degrees, of the opposite angle?
questions.hint: Opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral have a fixed total.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: What do the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add up to?
questions.hint: They are supplementary.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: What is the angle between a tangent and a radius at the point of contact?
questions.hint: The tangent touches the circle at right angles to the radius.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: The perpendicular from the centre of a circle to a chord…
options: is always equal to the radius
questions.hint: It cuts the chord into two equal parts.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A chord of length 16 cm is 6 cm from the centre of a circle. Find the radius in cm.
questions.hint: Half the chord is 8 cm; use Pythagoras.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A circle has radius 13 cm. A chord is 5 cm from the centre. Find the length of the chord in cm.
questions.hint: Find half the chord first with Pythagoras.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Two tangents are drawn to a circle from the same external point. What is true about them?
questions.hint: The diagram is symmetrical about the line to the centre.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: The angle at the centre of a circle is 130°. Find the angle, in degrees, at the circumference subtended by the same arc.
questions.hint: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: State the alternate segment theorem.
options: The angle between a tangent and a chord equals the angle in the alternate segment
Opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral are equal
The angle in a semicircle is 90°
Tangents from a point are equal
questions.answer: The angle between a tangent and a chord equals the angle in the alternate segment
questions.hint: It links a tangent, a chord and an angle on the other side of the chord.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: The angle between a tangent and a chord is 58°. Find the angle, in degrees, in the alternate segment.
questions.hint: Use the alternate segment theorem.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A, B and C lie on a circle and AB is a diameter. Angle BAC = 35°. Find angle ABC in degrees.
questions.hint: First find angle ACB, which is in a semicircle.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Tangents from point P touch a circle with centre O at A and B. Angle APB = 50°. Find angle AOB in degrees.
questions.hint: Quadrilateral OAPB has two right angles.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: In cyclic quadrilateral ABCD, angle A = 3x and angle C = x + 40. Find x.
questions.hint: Opposite angles add to 180°.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A tangent at T meets a radius OT. The line from O to an external point P makes angle OPT = 28°. Find angle TOP in degrees.
questions.hint: Triangle OTP has a right angle at T.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Angles subtended by the same arc at the circumference are…
questions.hint: They are 'angles in the same segment'.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Points A, B, C and D lie on a circle. Explain, giving reasons, why angle ABD equals angle ACD.
questions.hint: Both angles are subtended by the same chord AD in the same segment.
